# Public Social Account Analyzer — Implementation and Acceptance Summary

> Agent Skill and CLI toolkit for auditing public creator accounts on Bilibili, Douyin, Weibo and Xiaohongshu using separately sealed collection and analysis artifacts.

This is a summary, not the complete contract documentation. Read skill/SKILL.md and its focused references for execution. Review date: 2026-11-15. Source baseline: 69efd2be4064b9b144b5231b3f5ef86add9d4ba5. Repository version: 0.9.2. This documentation update is not a new package release or a fresh full-suite acceptance result.

## Supported surface

| Platform | Implemented surface | Acceptance boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bilibili | Public profiles, limited/bounded complete collection, metrics, independent attempts | P0 priority; real-account, accuracy and performance release gates remain open |
| Douyin | Public SSR/temporary browser, separate owner-authorized OpenAPI, public-index import | Conditional support; sources are distinct; real OAuth acceptance remains open |
| Weibo | Public AJAX, adapter enabled by default | P1 experimental; Cookie redirect isolation requires a runtime fix |
| Xiaohongshu | Modern/legacy profile-state parsing and visible cards | P1 experimental; cards without real note IDs remain partial and have no canonical post URL |

P0/P1 are priorities, not production certifications. There is no dedicated WeChat public-account or other-platform collector. Missing public fields remain null; public views are not verified private impressions, unique reach, retention or conversion.

## Runtime contracts

- collect.py takes a positional profile URL. --limit N requests 1–100 recent items. Omitting --limit defaults to bounded complete collection for Bilibili/Douyin and 30 items for Weibo/Xiaohongshu. --all is limited to Bilibili/Douyin.
- Agent-side nickname discovery must verify identity before passing a URL; the CLI does not implement a nickname search service.
- A sealed collection is the input to run_pipeline.py; an arbitrary CSV/JSON file is not automatically a valid collection.
- Analysis is offline and deterministic for fixed evidence and model-result inputs. Model flags generate prompts and validate externally supplied results; the CLI does not call an LLM.
- Every collection/analysis/checkpoint uses its own new output directory. Manifest verification, .complete, task status, delivery_ready and is_exhaustive have different meanings. Exit code 0 alone proves neither complete coverage nor a final strategy report.
- Read the actual selected_workspace from complete-collector output; do not hard-code attempt-1.
- --require-delivery-ready is the real pipeline delivery gate. There is no --strict-gates. collect.py has no --dry-run, --platform, --url or generic --cookie-file.

## Known unclosed boundaries

The Cookie-enabled adapter branch can force Douyin browser fallback on despite an explicit disable policy. The Weibo HTTP path uses default redirects with a normal Cookie header; an offline stdlib probe confirms header forwarding into cross-origin/HTTP target requests, not an observed real-platform incident. Neither defect was fixed by this documentation update. Do not claim these execution/security boundaries have passed acceptance.

Cookie persistence is opt-in for new cache writes, but existing per-platform caches auto-load. Input files and isolated browser temporary storage mean that “all credentials always stay only in memory” is not an accurate guarantee. The separate Douyin OpenAPI transport already rejects redirects.

The archive test depends on a developer-local packager path and may skip elsewhere. No current-SHA Actions run or fresh full pytest/package/live acceptance result was obtained in this review.

## Canonical documentation

- skill/SKILL.md: actual routing, CLI contracts, evidence limits and known defects.
- ROADMAP.md: implemented surfaces, P0 runtime fixes, repeatable verification and external acceptance gates.
- docs/acceptance/repository-audit-2026-11-15.md: fixed-baseline findings, offline reproduction and explicit unexecuted checks.
- skill/references/artifact-contract.md: sealed workspaces, task status and provenance.
- skill/references/collection-schema.md and analysis-schema.md: field contracts.
- skill/references/metrics-and-sampling.md: valid samples, denominators and coverage.
- TESTING.md: repository test procedures; a procedure is not evidence that it was run.
